ns2:section.sectionText: This course is designed to enrich student coursework experience through a series of invited speaker lectures (MSFE Practitioner Series), other professional workshops, field trips and conversation courses aimed at bridging the gap between academic work and industry. It will provide content, instruction and experience that will help students prepare for success as a (1) student, (2) job seeker and applicant and (3) professional in the U.S. business environment. Topics will include work/study habits, resume and personal pitch preparation, targeted job-searching, confidence and professionalism in networking and interviewing settings, presentation skills, oral and written communication best practices and goal-setting.
